shellCommands.command: git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && ls -la && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '/\.git/' | head -200
cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore src/*.tsx src/*.ts && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80 && ls node_modules | head -100

ls node_modules/@uiw node_modules/@gravity-ui && grep -n '"node_modules/@uiw\|"node_modules/marked\|"node_modules/markdown\|"node_modules/remark\|"node_modules/@gravity-ui/' package-lock.json | head -50 && grep -n -B2 -A12 '"node_modules/@uiw/react-md-editor"' package-lock.json | head -60; cat node_modules/@uiw/*/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"name"\|"version"' | head; npm config get registry; timeout 20 npm view marked version 2>&1 | tail -2

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -80 && grep -o 'export {[^}]*}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.js 2>/dev/null | head -c 1500; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -o -- '--g-color-text-[a-z-]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -20

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/ ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout; grep -n "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -20; grep -o -- '--g-color-base-[a-z-]*\|--g-border-[a-z-]*\|--g-spacing[a-z0-9-]*\|--g-text-body[a-z0-9-]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -30

timeout 180 npm install markdown-it@^14 --save 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn Unknown' | tail -5 && timeout 120 npm install --save-dev @types/markdown-it@^14 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn Unknown' | tail -3 && grep -A3 '"dependencies"' package.json && grep markdown-it package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat controls/TextArea/TextArea.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; cat controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; grep -n "view\|size" Button/Button.d.ts | head -20; echo ----; grep -n "variant" Text/Text.d.ts | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n "gap" build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "ButtonView =" -A3 build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8; for v in --g-color-line-generic --g-color-text-link --g-color-base-generic-ultralight --g-color-base-generic --g-color-text-hint --g-text-body-1-font-size --g-text-body-2-font-size --g-text-subheader-1-font-size --g-text-code-1-font-size --g-color-text-primary --g-color-base-background; do printf "%s: " $v; grep -c -- "$v:" styles/styles.css; done; grep -o -- '--g-text-body-1[a-z-]*' styles/styles.css | sort -u | head; grep -o -- '--g-text-code[a-z0-9-]*' styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -3
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn' | tail -40
rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff --stat -- package.json
